title: Depth-balanced causal interchange and commuting proof-state closure

parent.parent_verdict: AF-04 primary causal-advantage gate failed; depth3 interchange generalization deteriorated for eligible seed17

question: Does supervised causal interchange across two intermediate recurrence depths and a shared post/pre commuting-state constraint improve held-out deeper proof-state interventions against a forward-call matched status-supervised control?

semantics.oracle: Finite least-fixed-point forward Horn closure, independently checked against fact Boolean truth table and Lean4 decided graph expansion
semantics.knowledge_exclusion: The model observes initial-fact membership, role marks, public rule arities and stage/edge incidence; it does not observe derived Q0/Q1 truth, goal truth, donor targets, or future proof trace.
semantics.counterfactual: At the end of upstream recurrence, do(Q_selected := Q_selected from matched donor), with recipient's other subgoal unchanged, then recompute downstream goal via original AND or OR Horn rule.
semantics.patch_codes: Actual atom token carried latent (one/two float coordinates) at Q_selected physical node, donor full graph and untouched initial facts match. All other atom/rule codes retained from recipient.
semantics.control: Status baseline patches other subgoal with unchanged semantic value, carries identical recurrence calls and trains with original truth. Task-only baseline self-patches. Whole-code patch/direct-donor equality remains a numerical invariant.
semantics.lean_scope: Generated closed Boolean Horn formulas only; no model proof certification or general Lean theorem search claim.

datasets.branch_depth_definition: Depth d has d-1 sequential single-premise relay Horn rules before the final AND/OR subgoal rule, followed by the downstream goal rule(s).
datasets.manifest_guard: Commit canonical inputs, oracle labels, donor roster counts and hashes before training; reject mismatch.

model.native_cell: Verbatim source-hash-pinned TypedLoop(16) imported from AF-02; trainable in every arm
model.codec: Shared per-type affine-tanh encoder/affine decoder applied after EVERY recurrence update to both atoms and rules
model.readout: Shared Q0/Q1 binary classifiers plus goal binary classifier from role-addressed atoms
model.stages: Upstream incidence only for first phase, downstream incidence only for 3 calls; no replay of upstream facts in downstream phase.

training.batch_depth_balance: Exactly 16 train depth2 and 16 train depth3 sampled with replacement at every update, identical RNG per arm
training.upstream_prefix_curriculum: Alternating 4 and 6 recurrent calls per step in all arms; same donor and recipient indices each step, independent of arm
training.initialization: Identical fresh seeded native cell, writers, heads, and codec parameters per width/seed/arm
training.matched_forward_compute: Every training arm executes clean forward plus recipient and donor prefixes plus one patched suffix, with same selected upstream call count and same graph dimensions. Compare observed wall time separately; backward FLOPs may differ.
training.common_task_loss: Clean goal CE + 0.75 patched goal CE on arm-specific patch control
training.common_status_terms: For both status and causal arms: 0.5 upstream Q CE + 0.25 downstream Q CE + 0.3 patched Q CE; pre/post probability-state commutation MSE with weight 0.10, post phase prediction against pre phase stopgradient
training.causal_targets: Exact Horn oracle on do(Q_selected := donor Q_selected) for addressed-patch goal and both Q truth labels
training.status_targets: Original goal/Q labels under patch of unaffected other Q
training.checkpoint: Exactly final step, fixed schedule; development eligibility only, never tune on heldouts
training.smoke: Short engineering smoke is labelled as smoke, never used for scored conclusions

evaluation.original: Recompute clean original goal and two derived Q statuses from exact Horn graph
evaluation.secondary_tests: Layout transport invariance and untouched-other-Q locality, measured in all heldout families
evaluation.counterfactual: Two donor pairs per case; retain addressed, other-Q and whole-code logits, actual addressed latent code, exact chosen donor and oracle composition
evaluation.original_goal_control: Report task accuracy and false-positive goal acceptance separately from neural patch fidelity
evaluation.eligible: For each seed and width, BOTH status and causal arms must achieve >=.80 goal AND >=.80 exact(Q0,Q1) on BOTH train and dev
evaluation.primary_hypothesis: Every width2 eligible seed: causal addressed informative-goal-flip patch accuracy minus status baseline >=0.05 in EACH deeper heldout, causal clean goal accuracy within .03 of status, causal untouched-Q accuracy >=.90, other-Q patch goal retention >=.90, and causal false-goal attempts <= status. Eligible failures make aggregate fail, pass requires all seeds eligible/pass, else inconclusive.
evaluation.verification: Independent scorer recalculates every label, pair, original outcome, patch metric from raw per-case logits; replay checkpoint weights and actual Q codes for multiple fixed cases per family. Whole-code/direct-donor max abs error <=2e-5.
evaluation.outcome_policy: Engineering and scientific verdicts separate. Preserve eligible failures, ineligible seeds, and all counterfactual rows. Any tuning after observing heldout results must register AF-06.
